invariants: Every new or changed English string gets a Welsh draft beside it in the same change, as the service's other copy does.

Every changed page works fully without JavaScript: every state change is a form post, every search and filter a form with a button that submits it, and JavaScript only enhances a page that already works (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 6; conflicts:c-006).

A behaviour is built with GOV.UK Frontend first, then another tested government library (Ministry of Justice, HMRC, Scottish Government); no custom JavaScript is written to copy the prototype, pop-ups are not built and confirmations stay pages (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 5, 7 and 19).
Pages are built from GOV.UK Frontend components and govuk-* classes; the prototype's custom app-dr2-* blocks are not copied.

A search box is the real frontend's accessible autocomplete over a native select and behaves as the real frontend configures it; its entries are what MDM serves through reference-data, and only how the list reads follows the prototype (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 1 to 4).

Where a row changes a page or behaviour the high-risk plants frontend also has, the same increment changes plants too: plants mirrors the structure, wording patterns, components and behaviour, and keeps its own questions, data and step order (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 43 and 44).
Shared wording in a frontend's shared copy is never reworded in place; a set-specific string goes in the feature's own copy (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 41).

Notification statuses are only ever added, never renamed or removed, and each new status is mapped in every frontend that reads it before the animals backend first sends it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 42).
A page in its error state keeps the 'Error: ' prefix on its browser title (conflicts:c-006).

Every save control a page offers makes exactly the same checks on that page's answers, with no page an exception: a missing or invalid answer keeps the trader on the page with an error for each one and what they entered still shown, and the controls differ only in where they go once every answer passes (ruling:sam-2026-10-26).
Notifications, templates and address book entries stay scoped to the signed-in user's organisation (or user, for templates); nothing lists another organisation's records.
Each increment updates the tests repo's specs, page objects and journey helpers its change breaks, in the same change.

A change to a high-risk plants page, obligation or behaviour lands its own update to that set's journey specification, its decisions ledger entry and any guide that describes it, in the same increment as the change.

increments.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
increments.detail: A trader who amends a submitted notification is asked to confirm first, on a page of its own, and then lands straight on that notification's review page, where every answer and its Change link sit together. Today Amend on a notification's card starts the amendment at once, and the plants journey does the same; a notification's view page offers Amend as a button that posts and starts the amendment with no confirmation. After this change one confirmation page stands in front of every way into an amendment: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and Amend on the card both open it, confirming is a form post that starts the amendment and lands on the review, and backing out leaves the notification submitted and untouched. An amendment that cannot start, because the reference is unknown, the notification has been deleted or it is not submitted, changes nothing and returns the trader to the set's own notification list. The plants journey gets the same page and lands on its own review page. The performance suite's amendment journey follows the new landing.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Amend this notification' on a submitted notification's view page, and Amend on its card in the set's notification list, open a page whose title and level-1 heading are 'Amend notification' and which asks 'Are you sure you want to change this notification?', and the notification still shows as submitted until the trader confirms (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-046, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-107, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-108; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-181, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-055; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-078)

'Amend this notification' on the view page is a link that opens the amend confirmation page and leaves the notification submitted with nothing changed; 'Copy as new' on the same header posts a form of its own, 'Delete' is a link to the delete confirmation page, and no action sits inside another action's form (ruling:sam-2026-11-19 ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-007, ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-033; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-078)

increments.title: The cancel-amendment page is one question and two controls, and returns to the submitted notification with no banner, in animals and plants
increments.detail: Cancelling an amendment is confirmed on a short page: a question as its heading, no explanation, a button to confirm and a plain link back. Today the page asks 'Cancel this amendment?', explains that the changes will be discarded, offers a secondary button back to the notification, and carries the notification's status tag, reference and a Back link above the heading; the restored notification then opens with a success banner. After this change the page carries the question and its two controls alone, the restored notification's view shows no banner although its address still marks the cancellation, and opening the page for a notification nobody is amending returns the trader to the set's own notification list. Plants' cancel-amendment page changes the same way in the same increment.

increments.title: Copy as new carries over the trade answers and clears the shipment answers, from the submitted version
increments.detail: A copy of a notification keeps the answers that describe the trade — the origin, the internal reference number, what is being imported with its species, the main reason for import and its follow-ups, the additional animal details, the parties and the CPH number — and leaves the answers that belong to one shipment to be given again: how many animals and packages, the animal identifiers, the arrival, the transit countries, the transporter, the documents and the contact address. Today the record and the pages disagree: the record clears the internal reference, the species, the unweaned answer and the exit date, while the copy's overview shows counts, identification, arrival, transit, transport and contact address as Complete because the whole answer payload is copied across. After this change a copy keeps and clears the same list in the record and on the pages alike, and copying a notification part-way through an amendment copies its submitted version rather than the edits in progress. The plants journey has no copy action, so plants does not change.
acceptanceCriteria: A copy's origin of the import comes back with the source notification's internal reference number, and the copy's review page shows it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-063; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-048; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-078)

increments.title: A stale Copy as new from the view page returns to the view page and says the notification has been updated

increments.title: A notification needing action can be amended, copied and deleted as a submitted one can
increments.detail: A notification whose status reads 'Submitted action required' offers the trader the same actions as a submitted one, and every action must accept it, or the trader is refused on the very notification that needs their attention. Amending it opens its amendment and keeps its submitted answers aside; cancelling that amendment puts them back, and the status that follows from them; resubmitting records whatever status the outstanding items give at that moment; Copy as new copies it into a new draft; and Delete removes it and publishes its deletion. The animals sets only: the plants journey has no action-required status.
acceptanceCriteria: On the view of a notification showing 'Submitted action required', 'Amend this notification' and the amend confirmation start its amendment, as they do for a submitted one, and its submitted answers are kept aside unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Cancelling that amendment returns the trader to the notification's view showing 'Submitted action required' and its submitted answers, unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Resubmitting that amendment with the outstanding document now uploaded and nothing else outstanding shows the notification as 'Submitted', and resubmitting it with items still outstanding shows it as 'Submitted action required' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

'Copy as new' on a notification showing 'Submitted action required' makes a new draft carrying over the same answers a copy of a submitted one carries (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012)

'Delete' on a notification showing 'Submitted action required' removes it from the set's own notification list with the deletion message, and the backend publishes its submission-deleted event (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070)
